Base = iter-18 (the val_n=24 basis point: SSIM 0.975450, PSNR 38.74 dB; proj_n_bf=1, proj_sr=0.0005, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, img_sx=img_sy=2.5, n_iter=300, val_n=24, seed=42), which is the iter-12 CHAMPION recipe (val_n=16 SSIM 0.974822) re-scored on the larger 24-scene basis. ONE KNOB CHANGED: seed 42 -> 123 at the val_n=24 basis (isolated). EVERYTHING else identical to iter-18 (warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=24, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=5e-3, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, proj_sr=0.0005, img_sx=img_sy=2.5; proj_sx/proj_sy/img_kernel/proj_kernel at Wagner-abdomen defaults). WHY A FRESH SEED AT THE VAL_N=24 BASIS IS THE HONEST PROBE NOW: ALL knob families are exhausted and characterized -- IMAGE-domain (range img_sr tight peak, depth img_n_bf=3 peak, kernel img_kernel 7->9 flat @iter-6, spatial img_sx/img_sy full 0.5/1.5/2.5/3.5 sweep flat) and PROJECTION-domain (range proj_sr=0.0005 peak / 0.0001 flat, depth proj_n_bf=2 flat, spatial proj_sx 1.0->0.5 DOWN @iter-14, proj_sy 2.0->0.5 flat @iter-15), plus n_iter (300->600 flat @iter-7) and pretrain_epochs. NO ceiling-raiser remains -- this is pure ceiling-documentation. The val_n=24 basis, by contrast, has only ONE data point (iter-18 seed42 0.975450). The complementary honest confirmation is a SECOND seed at that LARGER basis: it turns the single iter-18 val_n=24 read into a 2-seed reproducibility set, confirming the larger-basis ceiling (~0.9755) is seed-robust and not a single-seed lottery. If instead SSIM swings by >0.0005, the per-scan fit has a seed-dependent noise floor (as demo-n2i's U-Net does) -- but the 12-param bilateral physically cannot overfit one scan, so a tight reproduction is expected. WALL: step budget IDENTICAL to iter-18 (n_iter=300, val_n=24; warm <=3x200=600 + per-image 24x300=7200); iter-18 ran 692 s, far under the 1800 s sbatch wall; outer_wall_s=1500 internal guard unchanged. WALL: step budget identical to iter-4 (n_iter back to 300; warm <=3x200=600 + per-image 16x300=4800); iter-4 ran 448 s, far under the 1800 s sbatch wall; outer_wall_s=1500 internal guard unchanged.

rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=6, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, grad_clip=0.5, lr=0.0001, unet_c=16, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-8 CEILING-CONFIRMATION PROBE: ONE knob grad_clip 1.0->0.5 on the iter-4 PEAK cfg (ep6, lr=1e-4, c16, n_iter300, val_n16, seed42 -> 0.9596). NOT-yet-tried axis = per-scan Adam GRADIENT-CLIP STRENGTH; it perturbs the per-scan optimization trajectory stability WITHOUT touching any read knob (val_n/seed fixed), so the comparison to 0.9596 stays apples-to-apples (unlike val_n, which would change which/how-many scans are scored, or warm_start=off, which flips the whole regime rather than probing a single knob). Failure-mode recap: ALL working levers EXHAUSTED -- per-scan lr 1e-3->1e-4 PINS each GT-free split-view fit to its warm-start init (iter-3 0.9553->0.9593); n_iter is NOT the lever (iter-2 n_iter600 DROPPED to 0.9407, no per-scan early-stop -> overfit); warm-start INIT saturated (ep3->6 0.9593->0.9596 but 6->12 REGRESSED to 0.9585, iter-5); CAPACITY is not the lever (iter-6 c16->c32 0.9596->0.9495); and SEED is noise-stable (iter-7 seed42->123 0.9596->0.9588, within noise). grad_clip=1.0 is the mandatory floor below which the 2304-view FBP adjoint can overflow on Mayo, but breast is 128-view (denser, smaller adjoint norm) so 0.5 should be SAFE and is the last untried optimization-stability axis. Hypothesis: 0.9596 is a SUBSTRATE FBP-bound ceiling (hr=0, < the 128-view LD-FBP baseline), so a tighter grad_clip lands WITHIN NOISE of 0.9596 -- documenting that the ~0.96 per-image U-Net N2I breast ceiling is gradient-clip-insensitive and structurally FBP-bounded, not an optimization-stability artefact, toward the iter-20 mandate. A material drop instead would mean the per-scan fit needs the looser clip to converge (an under-conditioning failure mode worth noting); a material LIFT would mean the per-scan trajectory was being over-clipped (capacity to climb after all). Wall: iter-4 (ep6,c16,gc1.0) ran 468s; identical cfg except grad_clip changes nothing about FLOPs/iters -> est ~470-500s, well under the 900s/15min wall (outer_wall_s=1500 hard cap).

rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=600, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-7, CEILING-CONFIRMATION PROBE. ONE-KNOB change vs iter-4 (the BEST base: SSIM 0.9732, PSNR 38.21 dB; img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005). KNOB: per-image fit n_iter 300 -> 600 (per-scan Adam steps in _fit_one_scene). This is a NOT-YET-TRIED axis on this run: iters 1-6 only touched IMAGE-domain BF axes (proj sigmas iter-2 HURT and reverted; img_sr iter-3; img_n_bf depth iter-4/5 peaks at 3; img_kernel iter-6 flat) -- ALL three image-BF axes (depth, range-sigma, receptive-field) are now EXHAUSTED at the ~0.9732 SSIM ceiling, hr=0 throughout (all under the 39.68 dB LD-FBP baseline). EVERYTHING else identical to iter-4 (warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=5e-3, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005 TIGHT, seed=42, proj sigmas at Wagner-abdomen solver defaults). TRAJECTORY: iter-1 0.9720/38.17; iter-2 (proj sigmas) 0.9680/37.90 HURT; iter-3 (img_sr tight) 0.9723/38.19; iter-4 (img_n_bf 1->3) 0.9732/38.21 PEAK; iter-5 (img_n_bf 3->5) 0.9729/38.18 SATURATED; iter-6 (img_kernel 7->9) 0.9731 FLAT. FAILURE MODE: near the breast bilateral 12-param structural ceiling (~0.973 SSIM); image-domain depth/kernel/sigma all tapped. WHY n_iter NOW (ceiling-confirmation logic): campaign-state knob insight warns U-Net N2I OVERFITS each scan with n_iter UP (no early-stop in _fit_one_scene: demo-n2i 0.4785->0.4293 @n_iter1200, breast-n2i 0.9553->0.9407 @n_iter600), BUT the 12-param bilateral PHYSICALLY CANNOT overfit one scan (only 12 sigma scalars, no pixel-wise memory). So n_iter is the decisive ceiling probe: if the BF is at its REPRESENTATIONAL ceiling (not under-fit), doubling per-scan Adam steps moves SSIM <+-0.0005 -- distinguishing 'ceiling' from 'under-converged'. HYPOTHESIS: n_iter 300->600 leaves SSIM within +-0.0005 of iter-4 0.9732 (the 12 BF sigmas already converged within 300 steps; extra steps just re-walk the same minimum), CONFIRMING the ~0.973 6-12-param structural ceiling is representational, not an optimization artefact -- the BF inductive bias approaches but cannot beat a clean 128-view FBP. If instead SSIM RISES, the BF was under-converged and n_iter becomes the next lever. WALL: per-image step budget doubles (warm <=3x200=600 + per-image 16x600=9600); iter-5 (img_n_bf=5, heavier per-step) ran 448 s and iter-4 ran 448 s at n_iter=300, so ~2x per-image -> est ~700-800 s, far under the 1800 s sbatch wall; outer_wall_s=1500 internal guard unchanged as the hard cap.

rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=1, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-1 feasibility, per-image N2I rewrite (commit 1f4c3394) on breast_ct (Sidky synthetic breast, 128-view sparse, real-mu range, 512^2) - BILATERAL variant. Short warm-start pre-pass (3 ep x 200 train, GT-free N2I self-sup loss) captures a generic BF-sigma init, then per-scene Adam (n_iter=300) on EACH of 16 val scans' own measurements, scored by evaluate_calibrated on the SAME val scenes as every other breast_ct method. Bilateral stack = 6 trainable params (proj_n_bf=img_n_bf=1, 3 sigma each); ~2x faster than the U-Net N2I. lr=5e-3 per Wagner-2022 BF recipe (solver CONFIG default); BF sigmas left at Wagner abdomen defaults for the iter-1 feasibility seed (the breast-tuned proj_sx=0.01/proj_sy=0.3/proj_sr=0.0005 from solver_dual_ddomain_bilateral_n2i.md hints is reserved as a clean iter-2 one-knob change). grad_clip=1.0 cheap insurance (breast 128-view adjoint is mild vs Mayo 2304-view). Sizing vs smoke: Mayo 2304-view BILATERAL smoke (job 764666) ran 6*... at ~0.125 s/(iter x scene); breast_ct is 128-view (18x fewer angles) so per-step is much cheaper. Steps = warm <=3x200=600 + per-image 16x300=4800 -> conservatively <700 s at Mayo's bilateral rate, far less on breast's lighter adjoint, well under the claude_agentic_one_iter.sbatch 00:30:00 (1800 s) wall. outer_wall_s=1500 is a hard internal guard on the per-image loop. Hypothesis: per-image bilateral N2I trains stably on breast_ct (finite val_score, comparison.png) and gives a usable per-scene recon; expect hr near the FBP baseline since N2I is structurally bounded by FBP on this dense-view substrate (the prior AMORTISED bilateral N2I was hr=0 / over-smoothing per solver_dual_ddomain_bilateral_n2i.md - the per-image rewrite is what is being tested here).
